adjudication.method: Confirmed uses require an exact checker-resolved declaration and concrete source use. Contract-preserved records require an exact inherited declaration and independently reviewed contract or override behavior. Retained candidates are indeterminate unless source review proves that only the declaration exists.

reviews.method: Two or more reviewers checked each record against the pinned source. Confirmed uses were checked for a concrete source use of the exact member, with accessor reads and writes credited to the matching half. Contract-preserved records were checked for the declaration, the heritage edge, the signature, and a required interface member, an abstract member, or an override that changes the behavior of the class.
